port_capacitance.note: C_gap_port_region_F: the electrostatic capacitance of the gap region alone (no fringing), a rigorous lower bound. C_gap_F: the same two terminal patches driven at V = +-1/2 on the whole domain, with the rest of their own conductor body insulating (n.D = 0) and every other conductor floating -- this adds the fringing field at the mouths of the gap. Both are lumped-element estimates: the body is electrically continuous around the port, so a capacitance across the readout exists only in the lumped model. f = 1/(2 pi sqrt(L_p C)) is an upper bound on the first self-resonance.
